one_liner: SE Ranking offers a broad REST Data/Project API with API-key auth, a 14-day trial with 100K credits, and an official vendor-hosted MCP server (OAuth 2.1 or API key).
auth_notes: REST API uses a single API key generated in the API Dashboard, sent as 'Authorization: Token KEY'. The MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, or an X-Api-Key header; the pages do not show OAuth for the REST API itself.
access_notes: 14-day trial with 100,000 free API credits. API package is standalone (no subscription needed); pay-as-you-go from $50/250K credits. Paid plans include monthly credits. No permanent free tier shown.
blocker_notes: Only a 14-day trial (100K credits) is free; ongoing testing needs a paid plan or $50 PAYG credits. The trial is enough to build, so friction is modest.
